entries.EN: Blind Dog
entries.JA_current: Blind dog
entries.JA_new: ブラインドドッグ

entries.EN: Several generations of the dog species have lived and died since the catastrophe. Each was more affected by the Zone than the previous. Rapid mutation lead to a vast improvement in previously peripheral abilities, frequently at the expense of primary ones. The most notable biological change was the loss of sight, paired with an uncanny development of smell. As it turned out, blind cubs survived in the Zone as well as normal ones, if not better. As a result, the common dog quickly became extinct in the Zone, giving way to a new breed. The animals instinctively identify and avoid anomalies, radiation and other invisible dangers that plague the Zone. Like their wild wolf ancestors, blind dogs hunt in packs. An encounter with a large group of these animals can be dangerous even to an experienced and well-armed stalker.

According to those who saw it and lived to tell the tale, the creature uses its tentacles to cling to the victim's throat, paralyze it, and suck it dry of blood with a mummified shell is all that's left of what used to be a living human being. However, the most astounding feature of the Bloodsucker is its ability to become invisible. Countless dead or missing stalkers are said to have perished in the merciless grip of a Bloodsucker. The lucky few who have survived an encounter tell spine-chilling tales of marshes and subterranean areas haunted by the Zone's version of Count Dracula.

entries.EN: Boar
entries.JA_current: Boar
entries.JA_new: ボア

entries.EN: A massive, mutated animal, reaching 1.5 meters at the shoulder. The Zone boar's aggressiveness and ability to survive by far surpass those of its relatives outside the contaminated area. Radiation and anomalies left their mark on the physical appearance of the animal as its fur is entirely gone in some places and long and bristly in others. The hooves have evolved into sturdy, sharp claws, while the pupils have became colorless with its bald head marred by pigmentation. Known to usually charge at their victims, trying to knock them over and then rip them to shreds.

entries.EN: Burer
entries.JA_current: Burer
entries.JA_new: ブーラー

entries.EN: These ugly yellowish pygmies are another mutant of possible human origin and an example of how the Zone is capable of altering the DNA of all living organisms, twisting them into nightmarish creations. These mutants inhabit underground tunnels and catacombs, as their sensitive eyes are too sensitive to daylight. They've been known to set up elaborate ambushes which strike any stalkers or science teams that delve into their shelter. Their usual tactic is to lie in wait as prey enters their area, after which they will quietly block all exits with large pieces of garbage, debris and concrete fractions thanks to their telekinetic abilities. Killed victims are torn to pieces by the dwarves' strong hands and then devoured. Interactions with other mutants are mostly peaceful, although blind dogs attack them without mercy. Burers posses a genuine intellect, and their vile character and nervous spite lead them to sometimes perform unexpected and savage deeds. Burers seem to telepathically sense nearby life forms and are able to determine their disposition without any visual contact. For this reason it is impossible to get in close proximity with a Burer without them already being aware of your presence. Their telekinesis allows them to distantly manipulate large objects, hurling them at their opponents at high speeds. They can also inflict powerful telekinetic blows directly on the victim and are even able to create telekinetic shields to stop bullets or pull a stalker's weapon from their hands. Burers are some of the the most dangerous mutants in the dark areas of the Zone.

entries.JA_new: 黄色がかった醜い小人のような姿をしたミュータント。人間に由来する可能性があり、あらゆる生物のDNAをねじ曲げ、悪夢のような存在へ変えてしまうゾーンの力を示している。目が日光に弱いため、地下道や地下墓地に棲む。ねぐらに踏み込んだストーカーや科学者の一団を待ち伏せしたという報告もある。獲物が縄張りに入ると身を潜め、念動力で大きなごみや瓦礫、コンクリート片を動かして出口を塞ぐのが常套手段だ。捕らえた相手は強靭な手で引き裂き、食らう。他のミュータントとはおおむね争わないが、ブラインドドッグは容赦なく襲いかかる。ブーラーには確かな知性があり、邪悪で神経質な性質から、予想もつかない残虐な行動に出ることがある。視覚を使わずに近くの生命をテレパシーで感知し、その様子まで読み取れるようだ。そのため、ブーラーに気づかれず近づくのは不可能に近い。念動力で離れた場所にある大きな物を操り、猛スピードで相手に投げつける。さらに、強力な念動波を直接浴びせたり、念動力の盾で銃弾を防いだり、ストーカーの手から武器を引き抜いたりもする。ゾーンの暗がりに棲むミュータントの中でも、ブーラーは特に危険な存在だ。

entries.EN: Cat
entries.JA_current: Cat
entries.JA_new: バユン

entries.EN: Much like many of the Zone's dogs, these mutants are remnants of regular house cats which were unfortunate enough to have survived the second disaster and replicated in the Zone long enough to become terribly mutated. Unlike dogs, which attack in packs, cats for the most part remain solitary and will hunt as single individuals. They are extremely stealthy and their claws and teeth have become elongated and exceptionally sharp. They are very aggressive and will now actively hunt humans as potential prey. Unlike dogs, which directly attack stalkers in large groups, a single cat will very quietly stalk its prey and attack from behind without making a sound. For this reason, it is arguable that a single Zone cat may be more dangerous than a pack of dogs. A popular campfire rumor states that some veteran stalkers have been lured by voices of others pleading for help from within deep foliage, only to be attacked by a cat leaping out of the shrubbery. So far, any proof for these cats being able to imitate human voices remains unproven.

entries.JA_new: ゾーンの犬と同じく、変異した猫の多くは、第二の大災害を生き延び、ゾーンで繁殖を続けた普通の飼い猫の末裔だ。犬が群れで襲うのに対し、猫はほとんど単独で行動し、狩りも一匹で行う。非常に忍び足で、爪と牙は長く伸び、ひどく鋭い。攻撃性も高く、今では人間を獲物として積極的に狙う。大勢で正面から襲いかかる犬とは違い、一匹の猫は音も立てずに獲物を追い、背後から襲う。そのため、ゾーンの猫一匹は犬の群れより危険かもしれない、とさえ言われている。焚き火を囲むストーカーの間では、ベテランが茂みの奥から助けを求める声に誘い出され、飛び出してきた猫に襲われたという噂がある。猫が人の声をまねるという話には、今のところ何の証拠もない。

entries.EN: Chernobyl Dog
entries.JA_current: サイドッグ
entries.JA_new: サイドッグ

entries.EN: \n \nAt first glance, looking similar to an ordinary pseudodog, the Chernobyl dog is capable of creating phantoms of itself with each of them able to inflict real and terrible injuries. The nature of this incredible ability remains unknown because no scientist has had the opportunity to study one of these beasts in captivity. These mysterious dog mutants have so far only been encountered within the Brain Scorcher area, but it is entirely plausible that there are more of them in the center of the Zone. It is precisely this inaccessibility that has prevented specimens from being acquired for study purposes. Scientists theorize that Chernobyl dogs possess a unique psi-ability, which grants them some kind of intellect possibly developed by the influence of the Brain Scorcher. Observations of these beasts in action revealed terribly efficient tactics, including encirclement by decoy phantoms while the original Chernobyl dog stays back and watches the slaughter unfold...

entries.JA_new: \n \n一見すると普通のシュードドッグに似ているが、チェルノブイリ・ドッグは自分の幻影を作り出し、その幻影も実際に相手へ深刻な傷を負わせる。この驚くべき能力の正体は分かっていない。捕獲して研究できた科学者が一人もいないからだ。これまでに目撃されたのはブレイン・スコーチャー周辺に限られるが、ゾーンの中心部にはほかにも生息している可能性が高い。近づけないため、研究用の個体を確保できずにいる。科学者たちは、チェルノブイリ・ドッグには独特のサイ能力があり、ブレイン・スコーチャーの影響で何らかの知性を得たのではないかと考えている。目撃例では、囮の幻影が獲物を包囲している間、本体は離れた場所から惨劇を見守るなど、恐ろしく効率的な戦い方をしていたという。

entries.EN: Chimera
entries.JA_current: Chimera
entries.JA_new: キメラ

entries.EN: The result of horrible genetic mutation on an unidentified organism? Perhaps a victim of cruel experimentation? The origin of this beast remains unknown. Adult specimens can reach up to 1.4 meters in length. A highly intelligent, strong and swift beast whose attacks and predatory habits resemble that of a tiger. Prefers to remain in concealment and strike victims from the back without a single sound. Doubled essential organs and vital systems lead to extreme levels of endurance with the beast able to survive wounds normally fatal otherwise. This is additionally amplified by extraordinary regenerative abilities. Their only worthy natural opponents in the Zone are Chernobyl dogs and Pseudogiants.

entries.EN: Civil Zombie
entries.JA_current: Zombie
entries.JA_new: 一般ゾンビ

entries.EN: The Brain Scorcher strips its victim of mind and reason, leaving only an empty shell. The brainless bodies then turn into zombies, following only the most basic instincts, wandering aimlessly around the Zone without weapons or clothing. Zombies are little more than sluggish walking corpses, caring only about food and sleep. They eat and drink just about anything they can get their claws on, thus they are virtually soaked in radiation and toxic waste. Usually they roam the Zone without any apparent purpose or just lie corpse-like in abandoned buildings. However, as soon as they sense the presence, they attack immediately and some are even capable of using firearms to a very limited ability. Experienced stalkers have learned to avoid them and preserve ammo.

entries.EN: Controller
entries.JA_current: controller
entries.JA_new: コントローラー

entries.EN: A rare humanoid mutant more commonly seen near the center of the Zone. Bears a superficial resemblance to a human with a disproportionately large head and diseased looking skin. Possesses a good level of intelligence and perception and has the ability to control the behavior of less developed creatures. Mature specimens are reportedly capable of taking control over the human mind. This may lead to the destruction of higher cognition, reducing the victim into a vegetative or zombified state or in more complex cases, may influence the victim to commit suicide. This is a ferocious enemy and even the most experienced stalkers are afraid of meeting it. Veterans warn that Controllers prefer to lay in wait and allow you to approach before striking though it is possible to sense the telepathic probing of a Controller if it is nearby, giving advanced warning of its presence.

entries.EN: Crow
entries.JA_current: Crow
entries.JA_new: カラス

entries.EN: The only bird species to have survived in the Zone, enduring increased radiation levels and effectively avoiding anomalies. While the army pilots need to rely on complex detectors to avoid gravitational disturbances, the crow seems to rely on its own senses; a mystery that drives ornithologists and biologists mad. Various theories attempting to explain the phenomenon exist, with all of them pointing to a highly specialized development of the brain.

entries.JA_new: ゾーンで生き延びた唯一の鳥類。高い放射線量に耐え、アノマリーも巧みに避けている。軍のパイロットは重力異常を避けるため複雑な探知機に頼るが、カラスは自らの感覚で察知しているようだ。その仕組みは鳥類学者や生物学者を悩ませている。現象を説明する説はいくつもあるが、いずれも脳が特殊な発達を遂げたことを示唆している。

entries.EN: Electrochimera
entries.JA_current: Electrochimera
entries.JA_new: エレクトロキメラ

entries.EN: A variation of standard Chimera, these unique mutants inhabit areas with an intense accumulation of electrical anomalies from where they are able to draw additional energy. They are notably harder to kill and way more dangerous than ordinary Chimeras. This is due to their ability to accumulate and violently discharge their static electrical potential. The mystery behind the beast's origin are shrouded in mere rumors and campfire stories. Scientists can only theorize as to the evolutionary processes behind the development of such an ability. Some of the most senior veteran stalkers claim that these mutants have only started to be seen around the Zone following a massive surge two years prior. The few survivors of this event talk about a sudden underground rumble in the Brain Scorcher area, followed by an enormous electrical discharge from a concrete vent leading to an unidentified subterranean structure. This discharge annihilated every living being within a 3km radius. The only creatures to survive were a small handful of Chimeras, and it is plausible that they gained their ability due to this cataclysmic event. It unfortunately wasn't long before they scattered all around the Zone.

entries.JA_new: 通常のキメラとは異なる亜種で、強い電気アノマリーが集中する場所に棲み、そこからエネルギーを得る。普通のキメラよりはるかに倒しにくく、危険性も高い。静電気を蓄え、激しく放電する能力を持つためだ。この獣の起源は謎に包まれており、噂や焚き火を囲んで語られる話しかない。科学者たちも、こうした能力が進化の過程でどう生まれたのか、仮説を立てることしかできない。ベテランの中でも特に古参のストーカーたちは、2年前に大規模なサージが起きてから、このミュータントがゾーンに現れ始めたと話す。生き残ったわずかな者の証言によると、ブレイン・スコーチャー周辺の地下で突然地鳴りがし、正体不明の地下施設につながるコンクリート製の通気口から、巨大な放電が起きた。その放電は半径3キロ以内の生物をすべて死滅させた。生き残ったのは数頭のキメラだけで、あの大災害によって能力を得た可能性があるという。その後まもなく、彼らはゾーン各地へ散っていった。

entries.EN: Flesh
entries.JA_current: Flesh
entries.JA_new: フレッシュ

entries.EN: Like most other living creatures in the Zone, the domestic pig also underwent serious biological changes since the day of the catastrophe. It seems the genes responsible for metabolism were especially affected in this case. Mutant pigs, known simply as "Flesh" among the stalkers, are one of the most vivid examples of the Zone's disastrous perversion of nature. Mutant pigs developed a protective layer of scales and exoskeletal plates. Their regeneration potential increased several times, as did the complexity of their nervous system. Just like a normal pig, a Flesh is an omnivore and may attack a stalker if hungry.

entries.EN: Fracture
entries.JA_current: Fracture
entries.JA_new: イズロム

entries.EN: Either a result of unknown mutations during some artificial experiment or the outcome of the Zone's influence on human survivors. Strongly marked hypertrophy of the extremities. Expresses slight psi-abilities. Humanoid outward appearance and the manner to stoop and hide its hand under a cloak give the mutant a look of a vagrant. The creature is artful at attracting stalkers by starting a conversation or asking a question. When the victim turns its back, the mutant stands up and attacks by means of its powerful extremity. Has been seen to feed on rats, blind dogs and fleshes. Rare cases have them chasing lonely stalkers, attacking them in the night.

entries.EN: Ghost Zombie
entries.JA_current: Ghost Zombie
entries.JA_new: ゴーストゾンビ

entries.EN: Nobody can give an explanation for the "ghost zombie" phenomenon. These strange creatures are different from common zombies because they are completely immaterial, resembling ethereal entities capable of attacking living beings. This could also explain their higher vitality when compared to normal zombies.

entries.EN: Plague Rat
entries.JA_current: Plague Rat
entries.JA_new: 疫病ネズミ

entries.EN: "Plague rats" are infested with a disease of mysterious origin. Some suspect they escaped from underground labs where they originally underwent bio-weapon research. In no time they managed to spread all over the Zone and multiplied, furthering the spread of the plague. Some scientists hypothesized that the rats originally emerged from lab X-18, where they had been used for testing the samples acquired by KGB agents in Great Britain after certain events during the late seventies. The experiments involved the cultivation of flies within the brain of the subject. The brain would first be primed for habitation by altering brain chemistry. This process resulted in creation of a perfect environment for the maggots, but the alteration of the brain was very soon followed by pseudo-death of the host. It is unknown whether this experimentation was ultimately intended as a bio-weapon against humans. For this reason, plague rats are best avoided at all cost with the effect of the plague on the human brain being unpredictable.

entries.EN: Plague Zombie
entries.JA_current: Plague Zombie
entries.JA_new: 疫病ゾンビ

entries.EN: Who said there are no dangerous insects in the Zone? It has been considered that way until recent testimony of "Fedka Pump", the only survivor from his group. They managed to come very close to the Brain Scorcher, where they encountered a strange creature, believed to be an ordinary zombie roving for food at first. As they got near, they heard a strange hum very similar to that of buzzing insects and the sounds grew louder as the mutant approached. Then, within a blink of an eye, the sky turned black and hordes of insects swarmed the stalkers, infiltrating every nook and gap between their clothing and armor. Fedka himself survived only thanks to the totally enclosed suit he had obtained from the ecologists for his good service. The scientists were the first to hear his testimony and they came to the conclusion that the so-called "Plague zombie" became an ideal "home" for a new breed of mutated insects, voraciously attracted to decomposing, radioactive flesh. These insect vermin have a habit of attacking anything that may danger their host. Within large hordes of zombies, they may spread with an alarming rate and infest others to create highly lethal walking nests for anyone without an enclosed environment suit.

entries.EN: Poltergeist
entries.JA_current: Poltergeist
entries.JA_new: ポルターガイスト

entries.EN: Supernatural in the eyes of some, these are invisible creatures that haunt the deeper reaches of the Zone, usually old, abandoned buildings. Nothing is known about their origin, although rumors in circulation claim they are spirits of stalkers hit by a massive wave of radiation. Their mysterious appearances and disappearances seem to correspond to the poltergeist legend, hence the name. Known encounters with poltergeists are quite diverse, from mischievous laughter and blood-chilling howling, to deadly fireballs appearing out of nowhere. Unfortunately, all information about the poltergeist phenomenon originates from unclear and contradictory stories of questionable validity.

entries.EN: Pseudodog
entries.JA_current: Pseudodog
entries.JA_new: シュードドッグ

entries.EN: Despite the name, the Pseudodogs evolved directly from wolves. The animals inhabiting the forests at the time of the catastrophe gave rise to one of the Zone's most dangerous mutant species. Pseudodogs are about as different from mutant dogs as wild wolves differ from poodles. The creatures mark and guard their territory carefully, attacking anyone or anything stupid enough to venture onto their land. Lightning-fast reflexes, uncanny dexterity and razor-sharp teeth make the Pseudodog a formidable enemy for even large mutants and well-armed stalkers.

entries.EN: Pseudogiant
entries.JA_current: Pseudogiant
entries.JA_new: シュードジャイアント

entries.EN: The Pseudogiant resembles a massive, drop-shaped abdomen with a pair of disproportionately large limbs which function as arms and legs simultaneously. The creature uses these appendages to move around and grab its victims. An adult Pseudogiant can weigh up to two tons and stand 2 meters tall. Their clumsy appearance might be deceiving, since they can move very rapidly if needed. Their muscles are exceptionally powerful and their bones are as hard as steel. The creature's brain is protected by a sturdy (up to 10 centimeters thick) skull, while many complex functions are controlled by the spinal medulla. Another astonishing feature of the beast is its ability to create local shock waves, which damage all living things in the vicinity.

entries.EN: Psi-burer
entries.JA_current: Psi-burer
entries.JA_new: サイ・ブーラー

entries.EN: Another horrible inhabitant of the Zone's many catacombs, a powerful mutant of possible human origin, twisted terribly by the Zone's influence. This malicious mutant differs from regular Burers due to a strange psy-aura which surrounds them. Apparently the ability to telepathically scan the environment developed into the power to extract "psi-energy" from its victim. Experienced stalkers who have encountered these dwarf mutants and managed to escape, spoke of a severe headache, vision distortion and disorientation when in close proximity to the psy-field emitted by the mutants. Survivors also mentioned auditory hallucinations as a possible effect. Some say those sounds are the screams of all the stalkers who died when their psy-energy was extracted.

entries.EN: Rat
entries.JA_current: Rat
entries.JA_new: ラット

entries.EN: After people abandoned the exclusion Zone during the first incident, rats flourished in number and continue to thrive in the Zone. They are expert survivors and instinctively avoid anomalies and emissions. Their main habitats are sewage headers, tunnels and basements. These animals seldom leave the underground, and will aggressively attack in swarms if threatened. The Zone did not influence their phenotype, although they now posses an increased resistance to mutation sustained from ionizing radiation.

entries.EN: Snork
entries.JA_current: Snork
entries.JA_new: スノーク

entries.EN: It seems these creatures were human at some point, though it is difficult to imagine what conditions could turn a human being into such a disgusting beast. Snorks are insane creatures leading a beast's life and differing little from other carnivorous monsters in the Zone. They move on all fours in long jumps, constantly sniffing the ground in hope of picking up the scent of prey. They hunt carefully, in a calculated manner, frequently setting up ambushes. Thanks to its uncanny reflexes and powerful muscles, the Snork can approach a victim, pin it down in one long, accurate jump and then tear it to shreds in a matter of seconds. Strips of army uniforms and other clothing are occasionally found on their bodies so it stands to reason that they are all that's left of missing military stalkers.

entries.EN: Tushkano
entries.JA_current: Rodent
entries.JA_new: トゥシュカノ

entries.EN: Although they bear a striking resemblance to jerboas, there is actually no link between the two. Attempts at determining the exact species from which this rodent evolved have so far been unsuccessful, although its ancestor must have been a gregarious rodent. Reaching up to 40cm at the shoulder, the animal is far more dexterous, aggressive and ravenous than its desert cousin. Mutant rodents live mainly in basements of destroyed buildings, feeding on everything they can get their teeth into, from plants to careless stalkers. Occasionally a pack of rodents will attack and kill large animals and mutants, tearing them apart before they can escape.
